Name: Reciprocate
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b][list]
[*]When NPCs receive gifts, they trigger reciprocal responses.Regardless of whether there is a return gift, it will increase the interaction response after giving a gift.
[*]Giving NPCs their favorite gifts significantly increases the probability of receiving a return gift.
[*]Continuing to give gifts can maintain the likelihood of NPCs reciprocating.
[*]Giving NPCs disliked gifts not only results in no return gift but also reduces the willingness to reciprocate in the future.
[*]The default list of reciprocal gifts includes items that are liked by the NPC's family and friends.
[/list][b]
Configs[/b][list]
[*]The content of NPC's return gifts can be modified inside  [u]Reciprocate/GiftData[/u]. You need to run this mod at least once first.
[*]You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]If you want to modify the dialogue, you can edit the files inside [u]Reciprocate/i18n[/u]. By following the rules in this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17714?tab=files&file_id=84961]file[/url]﻿﻿, you can add or modify content.
[/list][b]
Compatibility[/b][list]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ Mod with new NPC data and no forced dependencies.
[*]Supports [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV[/url]﻿[/b] Mod with new NPC data and no forced dependencies.
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and no forced dependencies.
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842]Mail Services Mod[/url]﻿ and no forced dependencies.
[/list]
[b]For mod authors[/b]
[list]
[*]If you want to modify gifts/dialogues in your mod or add new NPC content, please download this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17714?tab=files&file_id=119450]file[/url]﻿﻿, which contains a simple user guide.[b][/b]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Reciprocate
Manifest.Description: This mod adds a possibility for the villagers in Stardew Valley to trigger a gift-giving response when they receive a present. The likelihood of triggering this response is highly dependent on factors such as the frequency of gifts from the player and whether the gift is liked by the villager.
Manifest.Author: YunHikari
